summary: Practise Dynamics 365 transaction tracing, workflow review and role-based tasks in a five-day foundation course. Explore the course outline.
lede: Dynamics 365 transaction training helps finance, procurement and inventory staff trace routine records across connected workflows. Participants practise navigating workspaces, following finance, purchasing and inventory transactions, checking workflow status and financial dimensions, and using Excel to review a transaction extract; guided exercises also cover access and data-quality issues.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits staff who use Dynamics 365 to process or review finance and operations transactions and need a clearer view of where records, approvals and responsibilities connect.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with finance, purchasing or inventory transactions is useful. No prior Dynamics 365 configuration or programming experience is expected; coding is not required.
